items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Red Calendar formed a trio with me and the guitar player

ctx.x: So any way I spent that time there with Lester Young and all these things were very enjoyable. Would you believe it, after the band disbanded, there was no more work for the band, and I think Lee perhaps went back to California, and I think Lester got took a vacation or something, and we didn't have anything to do so Red Calendar formed a trio with me and the guitar player, you know.
Can't you remember that guitar player's name yet?
